name: Figtree Bakehouse
address: Timberlake Village, N2, Wilderness, 6560, South Africa
description_short: Artisan bakery in Timberlake Village serving freshly baked breads, pastries, and wholesome breakfasts.
description_long:
Tucked into Timberlake Village along the N2, Figtree Bakehouse fills the air with the scent of freshly baked sourdough and buttery croissants. This artisan bakery has become a beloved stop for locals and travellers alike, offering everything from crusty loaves and flaky pastries to hearty breakfast platters and gourmet sandwiches.

The relaxed, welcoming space invites you to linger over a proper cup of coffee and a warm slice of quiche or a decadent cinnamon roll. Their commitment to quality ingredients and traditional baking methods shines through in every bite. Whether you're stocking up on bread for the weekend or grabbing a quick breakfast before hitting the road, Figtree Bakehouse delivers honest, satisfying food in the heart of Wilderness.
